verdict.rationale: Pomelo is card-issuing and payments infrastructure, not an agent or AI client that consumes tools, so plugging third-party MCP servers into it is a category error. Its documented MCP (installable in Cursor, returning endpoints and code samples) is Pomelo acting as an MCP server for other agents. That belongs to the separate MCP-server story and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
